title: Designing the Banking Module Graph Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best demonstrates sound designing the banking module graph?
options: Produce the banking module graph, public contract inventory, DI composition map, ownership table, and dependency-rule tests before implementing screens.
Creating the suggested module tree verbatim without checking team ownership, variants, reuse, or build measurements.

Hide dependencies behind global lookup to reduce constructor parameters
questions.answer: Produce the banking module graph, public contract inventory, DI composition map, ownership table, and dependency-rule tests before implementing screens.
questions.explanation: The sound choice names the protected contract and requires observable evidence rather than structural appearance.

questions.prompt: What evidence should accompany the designing the banking module graph decision?
